title: Phantom Blade Zero Trophy Guide - All 36 Trophies, Platinum Roadmap
description: Phantom Blade Zero's full trophy list and a platinum roadmap: 36 trophies on PS5, 66 achievements on Steam, everything earnable in one run, and the six Tale trophies that expire silently.
keyword: phantom blade zero trophies, phantom blade zero trophy guide, phantom blade zero platinum, phantom blade zero achievements, phantom blade zero missable trophies

facts.label: Steam achievements
facts.value: 66 - 35 visible and 31 hidden; the PC list adds chapter and combat-move entries on top of the PS5 36

facts.label: Runs needed
facts.value: One. All 36 PS5 trophies are earnable in a single playthrough

facts.label: Difficulty trophies
facts.value: None - any difficulty, and you can change it freely

facts.label: Missable trophies
facts.value: Yes - six Tale trophies plus four boss trophies expire at the Mount Soulrend climb

facts.label: Epic Games Store
facts.value: 65 achievements - one fewer than Steam in the Chinese-language comparison

facts.label: Trophies not popping
facts.value: Fixed in patch 1.0302256 (4 November) per press reports - see below

sections.title: How the List Is Shaped
sections.content:
Every trophy below has its own page - the full tier-sorted list is on all 36 trophies.

The platinum is Defy Destiny, awarded for the other 35. Game8's assessment is that the whole set fits in one run at roughly 7/10 difficulty over 50 to 70 hours, with no difficulty-gated trophies and no bugged ones - the difficulty is entirely in not missing content, not in beating anything on a hard setting.

The category split matters more than the individual entries, because it tells you where the risk is:

CategoryTrophiesRisk
Story chaptersAutomatic on the main pathNone
Boss killsOne per named boss, including grouped fightsLow - most are story bosses
TalesSix Tale-completion trophiesHigh - several expire
GrindTempering, upgrades, collectibles, enemy journalNone, just time

PS5 and Steam are not the same list. The Chinese guide 177xz puts PS5 at 36 and Steam at 66 and warns that a PC player who works from the PS5 list will still have gaps, because Steam adds chapter and weapon-move entries. PlayStation players can ignore that entirely.

sections.title: The Missable Trophies
sections.content:
Six Tale trophies can become unobtainable, and the game does not warn you when a Tale expires. All of them must be finished before the climb to Mount Soulrend.

TrophyTaleWhat catches people
The Healer's LegacyFlesh Lily + Apprentice Healer + A Healer's MercyThree Tales, not one. Delivering a single flower is not enough.
The Last of BaishanSecrets of the Baishan SectMust be accepted before the Bai Chilian fight, not after.
Together Till The EndThe Journey HomeOld Man Gen's request - accept it before entering Pangzhen.
A Wanderer's HonorYoung Master LanSame window as The Journey Home; both start in the Village of Lu.
Spectral BladeSevering the MindsealEasy to walk past; not on the critical path.
Lost and FoundAll of Quick Hand Zhang's RequestsFive separate encounters. Miss one and the chain is dead.

The 177xz route note is worth following literally: chase 玉儿's Tales early, because The Healer's Legacy needs Apprentice Healer delivered before the Bai Chilian fight and Secrets of the Baishan Sect accepted before it as well. Both are in the Village of Lu / Crimson Forest window, well before the point of no return.

sections.title: Boss Trophies, Including the Grouped Ones
sections.content:
Most boss trophies are a single kill. Four are grouped, which means one trophy can hide three fights:

TrophyRequires
Master of the Misty WatersYou Loong, Yan Qiansui and the One-Eyed Archer
The Four FreedYuzan, Yubi, Yuding and Yucong - the four great puppets
Three Wardens FallCavalrybane, Soulclaimer and Heartpiercer
The Two Blade MastersZhu Yuan and Commander Bi Feng

The golds are With Heart and Blood (true ending), All Dreams Must End (Meng Hua) and The Four Freed. That makes the true ending unavoidable for the platinum - there is no version of this list you can finish on the ordinary ending. The checklist is on the true ending page, and the roster with locations is on the boss list.

sections.title: The Six Grind Trophies
sections.content:
None of these are hard, all of them are counting, and all of them are cheap to set up if you know the targets:

TrophyRequirementFastest route
A Tempered TenTemper 10 weaponsTemper the cheap Sanguine family first - the transformations count
Overwhelming ForceUpgrade one weapon to level 30One weapon only; the cap is 30 for all
Phantom ArsenalTemper 10 Phantom EdgesTempering is refundable, so materials are not lost
Skill Over StrengthUpgrade one Phantom Edge to level 30Same as Overwhelming Force, other slot
Listen to Every FlowerCollect 10 Memory FlowersMemory Flowers also gate the Dusk encounter, so this doubles as progress
Collector's NoteCollect 30 AccessoriesThe longest of the six - accessories are scattered rather than dropped

Unsung Legend is not in that table but belongs with it: it needs the enemy journal completed, which means killing everything at least once rather than only the bosses you have to.

sections.title: Platinum Roadmap
sections.content:
1. Prologue and Weeping Creek Valley - play normally. The Heart's Journey and the first boss trophies come free. Kill Hua, Deadly Betrothed before leaving the region; she is optional and missable.
  2. Village of Lu - start 玉儿's Tale chain and Quick Hand Zhang's first request here. Do An Unwavering Heart / chapter content as it comes.
  3. Before entering Pangzhen - accept The Journey Home and Young Master Lan, then finish both. This is the window 177xz warns about.
  4. Crimson Forest and Crimson Manor - all four Acolyte scarecrows except Hansui, Hansui last. Deliver Apprentice Healer and pick up Secrets of the Baishan Sect before Bai Chilian.
  5. Pangzhen - the widest optional window in the game. Clean the Tales here, not later.
  6. Meigu Lake - mirror realm, the Lóng Pillar inside it, Blizzard Blademaster and Whiteshadow.
  7. Mountain of Imprisonment - the Yin eye, plus Bi Feng and Jade-Face.
  8. Manual save before the Mirage Estate.
  9. Mirage Estate - the last Lóng Pillar, then commit to Mount Soulrend.
  10. Endgame - Meng Hua, Zuo Shang, then The Last Battle for With Heart and Blood.
  11. Cleanup - free roam after the credits covers accessories, Tempering and the journal. New Game Plus is there if something expired anyway.

sections.title: Trophies That Did Not Pop, And The Patch That Fixed Them
sections.content:
The first week produced a failure mode that no roadmap anticipates: achievements that satisfied their condition and never unlocked. Chinese coverage of patch 1.0302256 (今日头条, 7 November) lists it among the fixes and says the update grants retroactively any achievement that was earned but never awarded - so a player who killed the boss, finished the tale or hit level 30 and got nothing does not need a second run.

S-GAME's own notes describe the bug-fix block only in general terms ("several combat-related problems", "issues that could block progression") without naming achievements. The retroactive behaviour is therefore press-reported, not confirmed by the studio, and it is worth checking your own list rather than assuming: open the trophy or achievement list after updating and compare it against the six missable tales and the group boss trophies, which are the entries most likely to have been affected.

If something is still missing after 1.0302256, the practical order is: confirm the condition actually completed in-game (journal entry closed, boss rematch recorded), then reload a manual save from before the trigger, then report it. Do not start New Game+ to chase a single trophy before trying the reload - NG+ does not restore a failed tale, only a save from before the failure does.

sections.title: Sources and the Count Disagreement
sections.content:
Tier counts and the PS5-versus-Steam split: Game8's platinum guide, Gfinity's full list and 177xz's platform comparison all give 36 for PS5 with the same 1/3/14/18 split. Fextralife lists 66 for the combined PS5-and-PC set with a different split (1/3/22/40), which is the Steam-style count.

Not resolved: exactly which tier each grouped boss trophy occupies. Sources agree on the three golds - With Heart and Blood, All Dreams Must End, The Four Freed - and disagree on several silvers. The category tables above avoid asserting tiers for the disputed entries.

IGN's page gives 36 in one table and '50 trophies' in a summary line; 50 appears to be a typo carried from an early build, since 1+3+14+18 is 36 and every other outlet agrees.
